action.objective: Broad search all legal White moves at depth 4 to find the best plan against Black's e4/d5 setup.
action.rationale: No prior analyses; need complete root coverage before selecting a candidate. Position is a Two Knights/French-style structure where White's Ng5 is attacked-free but Black has advanced e4/d5 pawns. Black threatens to undermine, so evaluate all 35 legal moves, especially developing bishop moves, Ng5 retreats/captures, and central pawn breaks.
